messages:
Sam (Support): FYI — AcmeCorp trial is hitting repeated 429s for embeddings. Customer says the explorer is failing and they're demoing tomorrow. Escalating to CS for urgent handoff.
Maria (CS): Acknowledged. Please paste the error snippet and any tenant id so I can start a comms plan.
Sam (Support): tenant=acme-trial-81
Sam (Support): log: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-reset: 30
{"error":"rate_limit","detail":"embedding requests exceeded"}```
Sam (Support): Customer message: "We see errors when creating vectors, progress bar never completes."
Li (Infra): Looking — we're seeing a burst from that tenant: ~3k reqs/min, prefixed to embeddings queue. Rate-limiter tripped.
Li (Infra): Short-term options: (A) transient quota bump for 1-2 hours, (B) route to dedicated pool (needs infra change + approval). Which do you want?
Maria (CS): Short-term bump preferred, we need to stabilize before the demo. I'll own customer comms.
Raj S. (Success): I'll open renewal-watch flag and mark this account as high-risk until we confirm demo success. Maria, recommend the comms plan: 1) immediate transparent note + ETA; 2) offer a 30-min enablement session; 3) follow-up check-in 48h post-demo.
Maria (CS): Drafting message to customer now: "Thanks for the heads up — we're seeing rate-limit errors for your workspace. We're applying a temporary increase and will confirm in ~30 mins. We'll also schedule a quick walkthrough before your demo. Apologies for the interruption." Thoughts?
Jules (Billing): Quick note — we can approve a 48-hour temporary quota increase. Need an internal ticket with expected spike estimate to log charge waiver.
Sam (Support): Customer asked: "ETA?" on the thread.
Maria (CS): Replying to customer now with that draft. @Li can you apply the bump ASAP? If you need tickets I can file.
Li (Infra): Applying ephemeral bump of 2x current quota for 2 hours now. Creating infra ticket.
deploy-bot: capacity-change-request created: CR-2026 — ephemeral quota + routing flag.
Li (Infra): Done — headers now show x-rate-limit-reset: 120 and current burst allowed.
Sam (Support): Customer confirmed UI is progressing again.
Raj S. (Success): Great. Maria, please schedule the enablement session and add a renewal touchpoint in 30 days. Also capture feedback on what caused the spike (integrations? test harness?).
Maria (CS): Scheduled 30-min enablement for tomorrow 10:00am PT. Adding renewal flag and notes: "trial activation stall, rate-limit caused churn risk; temporary quota applied; enablement scheduled."
Jules (Billing): Logging charge-waiver request for the ephemeral increase; will confirm by EOD.
Maria (CS): I'll follow up with customer after the enablement and update this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam (Support): Closing loop from support side. If anything reoccurs ping me.
Raj S. (Success): Marking as resolved for escalation but account remains on watch. Creating a small retro with support + infra to avoid repeat.
Maria (CS): Noted — I'll add a short action item list: 1) confirm cause, 2) recommend client-side throttling, 3) consider onboarding script to avoid bursty imports.
Sam (Support): Thanks team.
Maria (CS): Thanks — will DM the customer summary in 15.
